value: Regenerate the marketing screenshot set: `tools/screenshots/shoot.sh` from the repo root (needs the iPhone 17 Pro Max sim — 6.9-inch 1320x2868 class). Because Demo is not a Package.swift target and has no Xcode project, the script builds it with swiftc directly: (1) SeaBearKit as a static lib for the sim (-parse-as-library -static -emit-library -emit-module, target arm64-apple-ios17.0-simulator), (2) the demo executable against that module, (3) hand-rolled .app bundle with a heredoc Info.plist + `codesign --force --sign -` (ad-hoc signing is required or simctl launch fails; run swiftc via `xcrun -sdk iphonesimulator` or the link step grabs the macOS sysroot). Sim prep: 9:41 status bar override, light appearance. Seven slides captured by launching with SIMCTL_CHILD_SEABEAR_SNAP=<menu|depth|list|form|palettes|custom|dark> (harness in Sources/Demo/SnapHarness.swift: picks the palette per slide, auto-pushes pushed screens after 1s via persistentNavigationDestination(isPresented:); palettes = snap-only PaletteGalleryView grid; custom = GridPatternBackground via the custom-background init; dark is shot under `simctl ui appearance dark`). Finals composed by tools/screenshots/compose.py (Charter Bold caption band, sea-navy ink #1B3A55 on sea-light gradient, rounded shot + soft shadow, pattern copied from Cairn's compose.py) into AppStore/screenshots/final/NN-<name>.png + _contact.png contact sheet. Captions live in compose.py's CAPTIONS list.
